resources.string: Choose input, connection and destination to enable Connect and play. Bluetooth must be on.
Turn on Bluetooth to see paired PCs and choose where to connect.
Allow Bluetooth access to load paired PCs before choosing a destination.
Select a paired PC above or choose Pair a new PC.
Connect to a paired PC without making the phone visible. Visibility is needed only to pair a new PC.
No paired PC was found. You can pair a new one or cancel.
BridgePad is ready for the first hardware validation.
Use the touchscreen or a USB gamepad as a Bluetooth controller for a Windows PC.
No paired computer was found. Choose Pair a new PC and Connect and play, approve visibility, then add this phone from Windows Bluetooth settings.
No USB gamepad detected. Connect one through USB-C.
Drag anywhere to move the PC pointer. Tap for a left click.
Choose your input, connection and destination. BridgePad sends your controls to a Windows PC over Bluetooth.
• For a new PC, allow phone visibility and add the phone in Windows Bluetooth settings.
• Use the virtual gamepad or connect a physical controller to the phone.
Bluetooth HID support varies by Android device. Steam may require initial button configuration. Console, Wi-Fi and USB output are not available yet.
Connect a USB or Bluetooth gamepad to the phone before playing.
A connection attempt is already in progress.
Works with more controllers. Keep BridgePad visible and the screen on.
Reads compatible USB HID controllers directly. You can leave the app or turn off the screen. This is input from the controller, not USB output to the PC.
Compatibility input is active. Keep BridgePad visible and the screen on while playing.
Background USB input is active. You can leave BridgePad or turn off the screen.
Touchscreen controls active. Keep BridgePad open to use the virtual gamepad.
Physical gamepad active. Keep BridgePad open and the screen on while playing.
Background USB active. You can keep playing with the app minimized or the screen off.
Choose where your controls come from and where they go.
Sends gamepad and mouse commands from this phone to your PC.
Wi-Fi and USB output are planned, but not available in this version.
End this session before choosing another PC.
Windows PC · Console support is not available yet.
The selected PC is no longer available. Select another PC or pair it again.
This Android device does not provide the required Bluetooth HID features.
Two sticks, a D-pad, face buttons, triggers and a mouse touchpad. More layouts and a custom layout editor are planned; there are no alternate layouts in this version.
Connect to the PC first to switch capture modes.
Button mapping is optional. Use it only if your controls need adjustment.
Custom mapping currently applies only to Background USB. Activate that mode with a compatible USB controller to configure it.
BridgePad follows your Android language: English or Brazilian Portuguese. On Android 13 or later you can choose a language just for this app.
